confirmed_plan_ref.description: Execute-only reference issued by the confirmed search plan.

count.description: YouTube page size. Omitted means 20; a confirmed plan freezes it.

cursor.description: Execute-only native next_page_token from the preceding YouTube page; omit from plan scopes.

order.description: How YouTube ranks the page. `date` returns the newest uploads first, so each hit's matched.published_at shows how recently that channel published.

published_after.description: Keep only resources published at or after this RFC 3339 UTC instant, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

search_plan_policy.description: Execute-only. Direct search requires an explicit request from the user.

confirmed_plan_ref.description: Execute-only reference issued by the confirmed search plan.

search_plan_policy.description: Execute-only. Direct search requires an explicit request from the user.

confirmed_plan_ref.description: Execute-only reference issued by the confirmed search plan.

search_plan_policy.description: Execute-only. Direct search requires an explicit request from the user.

all_words.description: Words that must all occur; each value is one word, or a space-separated phrase compiled in double quotes.

any_words.description: Alternatives compiled as one parenthesized OR group; each value is one word, or a space-separated phrase compiled in double quotes.

confirmed_plan_ref.description: Execute-only; omit from plan scope arguments. Reference issued by the user-confirmed onecrew.search.plan.prepare card.

count.description: Provider page size from 1 through 100; omitted means 20; a confirmed plan freezes it.

cursor.description: Execute-only continuation from next_cursor; omit from plan scopes.

exact_phrase.description: One phrase compiled inside X Web Search double quotes.

exclude_words.description: Words excluded from results; each value is one word, or a space-separated phrase compiled in double quotes.

from_accounts.description: X handles whose posts may match, with or without a leading `@`.

hashtags.description: Hashtag names, with or without a leading `#`.

language.description: Lowercase X Web Search language code such as `en` or `zh-cn`.

links.description: Include links, exclude links, or leave link filtering unset.

mentioning_accounts.description: X handles that matching posts mention, with or without a leading `@`.

min_likes.description: Minimum like count compiled to the X Web operator `min_faves`.

min_reposts.description: Minimum repost count compiled to the X Web operator `min_retweets`.

replies.description: Include replies, exclude replies, or leave reply filtering unset.

result_mode.description: `top` requests X relevance results; `latest` requests recent results.

search_plan_policy.description: Execute-only; omit from plan scope arguments. Set user_requested_direct only when the current user explicitly asks to skip the plan or search directly; never choose it autonomously.

since.description: Gregorian date compiled through X's `since:YYYY-MM-DD` operator.

to_accounts.description: X handles whose replies may match, with or without a leading `@`.

until.description: Gregorian date compiled through X's `until:YYYY-MM-DD` operator.
